name: Eurocodes (recommended values)
description: The Eurocodes with their recommended values, loads and seismic actions only (this version): EN 1990 (combinations 6.10 or 6.10a/b, characteristic, frequent and quasi-permanent combinations, ψ factors, partial factors of set B), EN 1991-1-1 (imposed loads by category, αA and αn), EN 1991-1-3 (snow on roofs), EN 1991-1-4 (peak velocity pressure, walls, cscd), EN 1991-1-7 Annex D (internal gas explosions) and EN 1998-1 (ground types, Type 1 and 2 spectra, importance classes, behaviour factors, lateral force and modal analysis, drift and θ). The material and member design tables (concrete, steel, foundations, detailing ...) are not Eurocode yet: they come from the pack it extends, BNBC 2020, until the EN 1992 to EN 1998 material packs exist. A National Annex is a pack that extends this one and sets only its Nationally Determined Parameters. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md for checking against the printed codes.
